result:
Round 466 is planned as STORE-2b-3c-2b, a test-only fix to the Store's "glow" scanner. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and nothing is blocked.

**Round 465:** C passed the retrospective with 0 bugs and browser checks done. The gate skipped it because no source changed, so the baseline stays at `6d321c7`. No new answers from Saba have arrived, and the STEM-LANES question is still open. `tasks/round-465.md` is an exact copy of the old task, and nothing was deleted.

**Why this task:** it is the order recorded at the last planning. The regression round isn't due until 2026-11-13, so it becomes round 467.

**What round 466 changes:**
- **Scanner:** the scanner that keeps zero-offset glow shadows out of the Store now also catches zero offsets in any unit or sign (`0rem`, `-0`, `0pt`, `0dvh`) and `calc`/`min`/`max`/`clamp` or string-concatenated blurs. It skips files that don't mention "shadow".
- **Findings closed:** A-R451-REVIEW-L2-ZERO-OFFSET-UNITS, INFO-TL-R451-GLOW-CALC and GATE452-L1-GLOW-REGEX-WHOLE-SOURCE.
- **Files:** two new test rows, TS7 and TS8. A applies my prepared patch to two test files, writes doc 304, and sets line 4 of doc 299 to `Completed (C round 466 PASS)`, because this is the second and last stage of STORE-2b-3c-2.

**What I checked on a copy of the code before handing it over:**
- Across all 657 source files, the old and new scanner give the same counts; the only difference is the test file that holds the new examples.
- I ran 13 deliberately broken versions of the scanner, and the new tests failed on every one.
- Chromium agrees with the expected result on all 22 examples.
- The full suite passes on the copy (4,188 tests, two more than the last gate). Typecheck and lint are clean.
- The production build is byte-identical to the current one, including with both doc changes.
- tech-lead reviewed it twice. The first review asked for the unit list to accept any unit, which I applied. The second approved the exact patch A will apply.

**Found along the way:** Tailwind reads test files, so three of the new example class names would have shipped as real CSS rules. I split those strings so they don't. The existing TS6 examples already put 5 such rules into production CSS today. I logged that as B-R465-TEST-FIXTURE-CSS-LEAK (Low, pre-existing) and deferred it, along with six small tech-lead notes (TL-R465-L1…L6).

**What C verifies:** the touched files exactly match the patch, the four related test files pass, the broken versions are rerun on A's code, the 657-file count comparison, the Chromium check, the build comparison, the docs, and the claims. In the browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720, C checks that `/studio-lab` opens without signing in and the purchase protection holds: the product page says "Sign in required" and the token API returns 401. Exact steps for copying the code are written out so C can reproduce my checks.

**Decisions I made that you may want to look at:**
- **STORE-2b-4:** it has no code of its own, so I moved its acceptance checks into STORE-3/4 and the design review. It is not marked done.
- **STORE-2b stays open** on those checks. The first design-philosophy review is due "after STORE-2b completes", so I left it to root: run it once round 466 passes, or wait for STORE-4.
- **backgroundClip:** the false positive where a variable named `backgroundClip` set to `'text'` counts as gradient text stays as it is. It errs on the safe side.

**Next:** round 467 is the 2026-11-13 regression round, carrying all its parked checks. Then STORE-2c (typography) through STORE-5, ARCH-SPLIT, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS and T12-ADVANCED. The next retrospective is round 480.

The advisor was available. I consulted it before choosing the task and again before finishing; its second check led to the doc-299 status change, the "STORE-2b stays open" wording and the exact copy steps for C. The store tree is untouched, at HEAD `6d321c7`. The backlog is now at version 462.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `b-round-465.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `backlog.json`
- `feature-status.md`
- `b-round-465/` (patch, review, broken-version runs, Chromium check, claims)
